contributions.detail: The single Schedule A row is 1,375.74, which is by itself the schedule's printed page subtotal, the schedule's printed grand total and the promoted PER-PERIOD cell Box B — three printed anchors agreeing to the cent. Box C YTD also prints 1,375.74 and is not summed as an increment. LOAN LADDER (§B3): the sole row is the candidate's own money labelled '(Loan)' by the filer; it is a CONTRIBUTION row because Box A 'Balance at Beginning' prints $0.00, leaving no beginning-balance slot, and Box B repeats the schedule's 1,375.74. The ladder closes: F = A + B = 1,375.74 and close = F - D = $0.00, exactly as printed. Classified by the ladder, never by the word 'loan'.

itemized.notes: MEMBER 2 OF THE KIM JACKSON THREE-DOCUMENT CLUSTER (449438fe / 713ed444 / ad8dc826), transcribed INDEPENDENTLY — nothing merged, netted or differenced with any sibling. CLUSTER VERDICT FOR THIS DOCUMENT (§K2): it is kind (3), THE SAME REPORT RE-PUBLISHED WITH A REDACTION PASS — not an original, not a revision, not a different report. The evidence is row-level, not total-level: the amendment question is ticked 'No' here exactly as on 449438fe; the report type is the same 'Seven days preceding the General Election'; the signature date and Date of Report are both 10/28/2024; the clerk RECEIVED stamp is the same OCT 28 2024 impression in the same position on the cover and again across the Schedule B grid; and EVERY ledger line is identical line for line — Schedule A's one row (12/28/2023 · Kim Jackson (Loan) · Provo UT 84604 · 1,375.74) and Schedule B's two rows (1/2/2024 · Utah County · Candidate Filing Fee · 712.74 and 6/15/2024 · BCR Political, LLC · Campaign Expenses · 663.00), with the same handwriting, the same raised-cents style and the same six summary boxes. THE ONLY DIFFERENCES ARE THE COUNTY'S: (a) on the cover the candidate's STREET ADDRESS, PHONE NUMBER and SIGNATURE are blacked out here and are in the clear on 449438fe, while City / State / Zip stay visible on both; (b) this copy is 4 pages against 449438fe's 6, because the blank duplex versos were dropped rather than any content being removed — the filer's own foliation is 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 on both documents, so both are the same FOUR-SHEET filing; (c) the channel differs (county_sheet here, state_municipal there). THE AGREEMENT IS CORROBORATION and is recorded as such: 3 of 3 amounts, all three dates, both schedules' two printed footers and all six summary boxes reproduce independently across the two documents, which strengthens both readings. No value was carried from the sibling — the geometry was re-measured and re-proved on this PDF (§K1).
